name: proactive
note: matrix-5 against matrix-5 with the two proactive pieces on: rollouts in which each side takes the hit the other cannot avoid (rollout_punish) and a bonus for closing in while the opponent's shot is on cooldown (press_bonus 2). Arena says 60% over 120 games (66% and 54% in two runs); the arena has overstated every gain so far, so the ladder decides. Every opponent, balanced by opponent, map and seat.
